key.name: show-idle
key.description: Idle sessions are left out of the top bar and the menu when off.

key.name: show-account-labels
key.summary: Show account names next to the lights in the top bar

key.name: show-mark
key.summary: Show the agent marks (Claude ✳, Codex >_) in the top bar
key.description: The marks are always shown when there are no sessions, and when more than one agent has sessions.

key.name: hide-when-empty
key.summary: Hide the indicator when no sessions are shown

key.name: pulse-waiting
key.summary: Pulse the light of an account with a session waiting for you

key.name: show-messages
key.summary: Show the waiting message under a session in the menu

key.name: refresh-interval
key.summary: Seconds between sweeps for dead sessions, Monitor scripts and background shells
key.description: Hook updates show at once (the status directory is watched); this only paces what no hook reports.

key.name: show-limits
key.summary: Show each account's usage limits in the top bar, next to its light
key.description: The shortest and the longest window (such as 5h and weekly) as stacked bars that empty as they are used, as in the menu. The menu always shows them.

key.name: limits-interval
key.summary: Seconds between checks of the usage limits of the Codex accounts with a working session
key.description: Idle accounts use nothing, so they are not checked; an account is checked once more when its sessions stop working. Claude Code's limits come from its status line while its sessions run, so they need no check.

key.name: account-order
key.summary: Account ids in the order they are shown (codex:<id> for Codex); accounts not listed come after, alphabetically

key.name: account-names
key.summary: Display names for account ids (the hook's id, from the CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR name; codex:<id> for Codex, from CODEX_HOME)

key.name: panel-box
key.summary: Top bar area the indicator sits in
